entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Anyone here taking\nthe Gym Test?! ▶

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You’re taking the Gym Test, aren’t you? I can tell!\nGet ready to spill the beans about your clue!

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Do...do I have to tell you my clue since I lost?

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
Fine, here’s my clue: Listen really closely to
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]the blue bird Pokémon[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!\c
I’m still puzzling over that word it said. All that
thinking kept me from focusing on the battle...

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’ve got to order\nthat secret dish... ▶

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Do you have a clue about the secret dish? Guess\nI’d better beat you and learn it!

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I can’t believe this Gym Test makes us steal each\nother’s clues... That’s fighting dirty!

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
The clue I was given is to look for...[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]a dark spot[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]surrounded by stairs[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!\c
I don’t remember seeing any particularly dark
spots in this town...

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_03_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’m gonna beat\nthe Medali Gym! ▶

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_03_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: ’Scuse me! You’re taking the Gym Test, right?\nTell me your clue about the secret dish!\r\nC’mon! Tell me, tell me, tell meee!

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_03_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I wish we could just trade clues like we trade\nPokémon...

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_03_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
My clue is to look for something that’s [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]the odd[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]one out at one of the ice cream stands[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].\c
Come to think of it, I could use some ice cream
as a pick-me-up since I lost!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Hey, let’s battle! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: If you talk to a Pokémon Trainer like me, it means\nwe’re gonna battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Your Pokémon are strong, huh!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Here in Paldea, you gotta talk to a Pokémon\nTrainer to challenge ’em. We can’t tell if you\r\nwanna battle just by making eye contact!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Got my Pokémon\nall healed up! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: If you can beat me, I’ll tell you a cool secret!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Awww, I lost... Even though my Pokémon had\nfull HP...

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Here’s the secret: Pokémon Centers will heal all\nyour Pokémon...for FREE!\c\nWhat do you mean, you already knew that?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I bought everything I need.\nI’m all set! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Perfect timing! You wanted to challenge me to a\nPokémon battle, right?

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Ooof. I stepped up and got smacked down.

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Guess I better heal up my Pokémon. Good thing\nI bought these Potions at the Poké Mart...

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: What a cool Pokémon! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Lemme show you this awesome-lookin’ Pokémon\nI just caught!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I guess just looking cool doesn’t cut it.

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I caught my Chewtle pretty close to a pond.\nMaybe Water types like hanging out near water...

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Gotta get stronger! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m gonna defeat you so my Pokémon can get\neven tougher!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Maybe my Pokémon’s level isn’t high enough...

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The more you battle, the more you can raise your\nPokémon’s levels! Ever stronger!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Heh heh heh!\nI’ve got TWO! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I got two whole Pokémon! Am I cool or what?

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Waaah! My two Pokémon!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: When you battle, the Pokémon at the top of your\nteam gets sent out first! Every Pokémon Trainer’s\r\ngotta know that!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Heading to school? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Got time to battle a fella like me on your way\nto school?

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Safe trip, then!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: This road’ll take you right to Mesagoza, where\nthe school is! Don’t get lost, now.

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Hiking’s real simple! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ll tell you all you need to know about hiking!\nRule one: Work those legs!\r\nRule two: Work those legs!!!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You wanna know the third and fourth rules?\nThere are none! It’s all legs, kiddo!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Climbing mountains means tackling some slopes!\c\nI’m sure even a kiddo like you can make it up a\nhill like the one leading into Mesagoza, if you try!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Any Trainer worth\ntheir salt knows... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Pop quiz! What happens when a Pokémon’s HP\nruns out?

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: The answer is, as you can see...they get too\nexhausted to fight!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: When a Pokémon loses all its HP and faints, you\ncan’t make it better with a Potion. You’ve got to\r\ntake it to a Pokémon Center!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Guess this is it? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I came to Mesagoza to make some deliveries...\nbut let’s have a quick battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Guess I delivered you a win!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Mesagoza’s so massive, it’s easy to get lost if you\ndon’t check your map app.

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: That door was\nso weird... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I can’t stop wondering what’s behind that weird\ndoor, or lid, or cover, or whatever it was...\c\nMaybe a battle will take my mind off it!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Just what could be behind that— Whoa, wait,\nI lost?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
In a rock face past here, there’s a door or lid or
something that’s chained shut!\c
There was a faint light coming through it. I
wonder what could be in there...

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’m the strongest in Area One\nof the South Province! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Do you think you can topple me—the mightiest\nmartial artist here?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Very well! Henceforth, I am the second mightiest!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I wonder if there are people even stronger than\nus outside Area One of the South Province...

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The Pokémon League\nbuilding looks so cool! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m makin’ my way to the Pokémon League! Let’s\nbattle to mark the occasion!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Well, losing’s one way to mark an occasion!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I don’t have any Gym Badges yet, but maybe I’ll\nsit for the interview and see if I pass anyway...

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Takin’ on the League? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You look like you’ve got promise, kid. Let’s give\nyou a challenge to grow on!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Hahaha! Did you get some growth out of that?

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: If battling me helps you grow stronger and you\nbecome a Champion one day, that means I’m a\r\npart of what made you a Champion! Right?

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Rrrgh! I’m so careless! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I can’t believe I forgot to buy ingredients! Maybe\na rumble will calm my rumbling tummy!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Rrrgh. I’m so disappointed.

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I was really excited to have a picnic, make a\nsandwich, and eat it with my Pokémon...

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Hey, you there! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I hope you’re getting enough to eat!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Good! You seem well!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: When you need a bite, have a sandwich!\c\nYou ought to stock up on ingredients so you can\nmake one anytime!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Gonna train up my bug\nPokémon real strong! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m out getting my bug Pokémon a lot of\nexperience!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Aww, I bet I coulda beat you if I’d evolved my\nPokémon...

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I hear bug Pokémon evolve quicker than other\nPokémon! Maybe my Kricketot will evolve soon...

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Have you seen the\nTen Sights of Paldea? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Want to know the way to one of the Ten Sights\nof Paldea?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: This is a sight I’ve never seen!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The Grand Olive Orchard, one of the Ten Sights\nof Paldea, is a little past that Pokémon Center!\r\nJust follow the path—you can’t miss it.

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: What a haul! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I collected a ton of materials Pokémon dropped.\nNow I think I’ll start collecting some prize money!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Fine, you can have some prize money... But you\ncan’t have my materials!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I need to make some TMs. That’s why I was out\ngathering materials that Pokémon drop.

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Which way to the Gym? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Check me out—I’m 60 and still kickin’! I’m even\noff to take on a Gym!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Check me out—I’m 60 and getting beat before\nI even get to the Gym...

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: My daughter keeps telling me, “If you get lost,\npress the Y Button to check your map app!”\r\nMap app? Sounds like claptrap to me...

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I wanna catch ’em! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Could I catch the Pokémon you trained?\nPleeease, could I?

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Guess you can’t catch people’s Pokémon...

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I don’t want to be a thief! I’ll just catch wild\nPokémon.

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Please tell me the way! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Where am I supposed to go from here? I haven’t\ngot a clue—I’m just aimlessly wandering...

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Was losing to you supposed to help me find\nmy way?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: If you get lost and don’t know where to go, like\nme...try asking at the Pokémon Center.

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Hey, are we\nschoolmates?! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You go to the academy too, right? Let’s pool our\nknowledge and trade tips...after we battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: How do you know so much more than me when\nwe’ve been taking the same classes?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Across the river, you’ll find the South Province’s\nArea Four. It’s got stronger Pokémon than here!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Do you have one? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You’ve got a Tera Orb, right?! That’s so cool!\nLemme see, lemme see, lemme see!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: So sparkly I got distracted!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
Some Pokémon change into different types when
they Terastallize, right?\c
I wish I had a Scatterbug that could turn into a
Fire type. That’d be so cool...

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Pokémon quiz tiiime! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: What’s two feet, four inches tall and weighs\n45.2 pounds?

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Did you figure out the answer?

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: You should have Gible registered in your\nPokédex now, thanks to our battle! Check out its\r\nhabitat and see if you can catch one!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Oh, happy day! ♪ ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I bought some delicious cake from Patisserie\nSoapberry! Let’s celebrate with a battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: This cake makes me so happy, I don’t even\nmind losing!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Katy, who runs Patisserie Soapberry, is the best\npatissier around. And she’s even a Gym Leader!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Welcome! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Can I interest you in our daily battle special?\nOur regulars say it’s electrifying!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: That’s it. I’m closing up shop.

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Lots of customers have to go buy a Paralyze Heal\nafter they try my battle special. Hee hee!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’m so curious about\nTeam Star... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You go to the academy, right? Do you know\nabout Team Star?

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I was so busy thinking about Team Star, I lost...

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I hear Team Star builds bases and claims whole\nlittle zones for themselves.

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: You a new kid? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hey, new kid! I know what’s up around here.\nLemme take a look at your Pokémon for ya!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: OK, that was legit hilarious!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Check out these words of wisdom: Those big\nPokémon Center signs make great landmarks.\r\nMakes you less likely to end up lost!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: You know the\nArtazon Gym? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Have you been to the Artazon Gym? I sure have!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: The tragedy I went through at the Artazon Gym\nhas struck again!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The Gym Leader, Brassius, absolutely wiped the\nfloor with me.

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Sparkle, sparkle!\nTwinkle, twinkle! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hey! I gotta tell you about this! It was all\nsparkly...and all twinkly!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Now we’re all bruise-y and lose-y.

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I saw this sparkly Pokémon and I went up to try\nand catch it...when it suddenly Terastallized!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Dun, dun, dun-da-dun! ♪ ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Dun, dun, dun-da-dun! ♪ That’s the sound of\nhealing up at the Pokémon Center!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Guess I better go ask for another round of\ndun, dun, dun-da-dun...

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Maybe I ought to buy some Potions while I’m at\nthe Pokémon Center.

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Let’s show each other\nwhat we’ve got! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Here, I’ll show you my Pokémon first!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I got shown more than I bargained for...

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Pokémon you see in battle get registered in your\nPokédex app, so I try to battle a lot.

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’m gonna scare\n’em so bad! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Suddenly, from the bushes... BOO!!! Ha! Bet you\nnever saw that coming!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I lost?! I didn’t see that coming at all!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Maybe something good’ll happen if I sneak up\non a Pokémon that doesn’t see me coming...

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: It was incredible! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: There was—! That rock wall—! There was a—!\nThat Pokémon—! Incredible! You know?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I think losing to you has calmed me down.

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I was leaning on this rock wall, and suddenly it\njust started...moving! It scuttled up the cliff!\c\nWas that thing I thought was a wall...a Pokémon?

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Treasure hunting... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You’re doing the Treasure Hunt, aren’t you? I did\nit too, back in the day.

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Ah, to be young...

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The Treasure Hunt’s basically tradition at\nthe academy.

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I want a jolt of\ninspiration! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I want to write a song, but it just won’t come to\nme... I need some kind of spark!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Now THERE’S a spark!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I bet I can write a fine song with that jolt of\ninspiration you gave me!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Heeey! Guess! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hey! Guess who my favorite teacher at the\nacademy is?

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Iiit’s...Mr. Jacq!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: You’re in Mr. Jacq’s class?! Lucky!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Well, for now... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: For now...let’s battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I lost...for now!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I’ve got no idea what to do on my Treasure Hunt.\nFor now, I just gotta figure out the next step...

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Battle me,\nfor I am mighty! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Battle me, for I have given my Pokémon a mighty\nitem to hold...and I am mighty!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: My might and my items meant nothing in the face\nof a mighty Trainer like you!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
I gave one of my Pokémon some Leftovers to
hold so it’d recover HP bit by bit!\c
You can spot mighty Trainers like me by how we
speak. Our strength colors everything we say.

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Makin’ the rounds,\nround and round... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m out making the rounds! Which means I’m on\nthe job, but I’m out and about!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: My surroundings are spinning round and round...

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: It’s kinda nice to get to be outside while I’m\nat work.

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I need a model\nfor my new work... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I think my next work shall be a portrait...of you,\ncollapsed in defeat!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Battle... Art... Both are fiendishly tough pursuits!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I still need to find a model for my next piece.\nPreferably someone I can beat.

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: It’s all about balance! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ve got Pokémon of a bunch of different types,\nso we can have a well-balanced battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Agh! Now I’m off-balance!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Having different types of Pokémon with you\nshould help you handle different situations!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The Treasure Hunt\nis so much fun! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m doing the Treasure Hunt, too. And no fresh-\nfaced kid is gonna beat me!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: If that’s how you battle, I’m sure you’ll be able to\nfind your treasure!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: No matter how old you get, having new life\nexperiences is always a treasure!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Come say hi!\nCome say hiii! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Yaaay! You came! So, wanna baddle?

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You baddle really good!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: When someone says somefin’ that gets your\nattention, you just gotta talk to ’em, right?

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: My own secret base! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: This right here is my secret base! I’m gonna beat\nyou and then you gotta go!

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: What?! Wait, does this mean I have to go?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: It’s tough getting all the way up here to our\nsecret base, huh?

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Scrub-a-dub! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Are you washing your Pokémon nice and clean?

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I got washed away!

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Area Four of the South Province is a big place—\nplenty of room for a thorough Pokémon washing!\r\nA little of that fresh feeling goes a long way!

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Begging your pardon... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Begging your pardon... Could I trouble you for\na battle?

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I’m begging your par-done for!

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I guess in those old-timey shows, when people\nbeg someone’s pardon, they’re usually asking for\r\nhelp or directions or something, not a battle.

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’ve covered up\nmy weakness! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: This Berry is my ace in the hole! It’s covered up\nmy weakness!

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Even with one less weakness, I lost...

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: There’re some Berries that Pokémon can hold to\ntake less damage from a supereffective move.\r\nGives you one less thing to worry about!

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Treasure ahoy! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I know where there’s treasure! Maaaybe I’ll tell\nyou...if you can beat me!

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: The real treasure was definitely not meeting you!

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I saw a treasure chest up on top of that tower!\nBut it started moving around on its own, so I, uh,\r\ngot kinda freaked out and didn’t open it...

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Good ol’ Pokédex! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I love filling in my Pokédex! Don’t you?

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I don’t love battles quite as much.

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Your Pokédex will tell you where Pokémon’s\nhabitats are and when you might find them!

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I wanna see! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I wanna see the cute li’l Pokémon you’ve got\nwith you!

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Awww! What [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0607)]a cutiecuties!

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: There’re so many kinds of Pokémon! And they’re\nso cute!

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Is this a dead end? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: It feels like such a waste to hit a dead end and\njust turn back with nothing to show. So...shall we?

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I should have just turned back...

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: If I just had a way to ride a Pokémon up cliffs,\nI could get to the South Province’s Area Six...

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Excuse me! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Let’s get down to it. Please forgive my being\nbarefoot.

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Perhaps I’d have had a chance if I’d been\nwearing boots...

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I know other Black Belts go around barefoot...\nDo rocks and things just not hurt them?

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Are these Pokémon\njust too strong? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Is it me, or are the Pokémon around here way too\nstrong? We should probably turn back, huh?

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I guess I’d be fine out here if I were as strong as\nyou are.

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Beating stronger Pokémon makes you stronger in\nturn, but that only works if you can actually win...

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Two whole decades! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ve got twenty years of studies at the academy\nunder my belt!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Twenty years...for this...

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I was so short on credits I had to take a 20th\nyear! Maybe it’s time I graduated...

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: If you shorten pants... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: If you shorten pants, do you get a pan?

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Now I’ve got short pants, but a long face...

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Would you say you’re more of a shorts person or\na pants person?

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: How about it? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: How about a nice Pokémon battle? I’ve got some\nspare time and I’d like to do something fun!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Ahhh, that was fun.

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Some moves look cool, some moves hit hard...but\nmy favorites are the ones that are just plain fun.

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Do you know of Kofu? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Kofu, the Cascarrafa Gym Leader, is quite strong!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I guess now you know how strong I am!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Kofu is a user of water Pokémon! Take care lest\nyou be swept away by his strategy!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The Great Crater\nof Paldea... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Why is the Great Crater of Paldea off-limits,\nI wonder?

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Guess if a kid can beat me, I’m better off not\ngoing anywhere dangerous...

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I heard the depths of the Great Crater of Paldea\nare defended by a super-powerful guardian!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’ve got a guitar... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ve got a guitar that doesn’t make a sound!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I’m as victorious as my guitar is loud...

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Sometimes I carry around my silent guitar to\ntoughen up my arms and neck!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The joy of youth! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: What is youth, though? Do you have an answer?

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Aaah, the folly of youth...

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Maybe you only really understand your youth\nwhen you look back on it as an adult.

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: A weird Pokémon! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: There was a weird Pokémon! There was a weird\nPokémon!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I saw a weird Pokémon, I swear! I’ll tell you more\nin a bit!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I ran into a weird Pokémon out in the desert.\c\nIt looked like Donphan, but I think it actually\nwas a different Pokémon...

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: So much sand! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: What d’you think will happen if sand gets into\nmy shoes?

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Maybe I’ll just go bury my head in the sand!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: If the sand stays inside my shoes for too long,\nI start to grow fond of it!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Yooo-hooo! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Yaaa! Huagh?! Hey, how’d you get up here?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oooh, by riding your Pokémon!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Your Pokémon climbed up here, right?\n...Wait, can Cyclizar climb?

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’m a worker! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m a worker! If you need work done, I’m\nyour man!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Pokémon battles aren’t work!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Workers like me can build any kind of building,\nwhether it’s a school or the Pokémon League HQ!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Teach me! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Teach me! Teach me the feeling of defeat!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: So this is what defeat feels like!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Defeat’s really something else. Thanks for\nteaching me!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Don’t worry! I’ve got it! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Yes, I’ll take care of this mess... I’ll clean you out!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You’ve cleaned me out!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: No matter how messy battles get, I love to\nsee them!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I forgot to do\nmy homework! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I forgot to do my homework! If I win, you gotta\nlet me copy yours!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Wait, we’re not even in the same class...

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: So, which classes are you taking? I’m in, like,\nbattle studies and biology and stuff!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Hikers are super popular! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I heard that I’d be super popular if I became\na Hiker!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Hiking up the mountain of popularity!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I guess Hikers are popular with Pokémon. I’m OK\nwith that!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I spy a mountain! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: A mountain of an opponent! Let me reach\nyour summit!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Coming down off the mountain...

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I guess you were too much of a mountain for me!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I have this really\ncool classmate! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I have a classmate whose [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0303)]momdad is a famous\nprofessor!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: There’s nothing particularly cool about me.

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Don’t you think it’d be cool to have a parent\nthat’s famous?

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: She was so strong... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: A superstrong girl asked me to battle! I lost\nbefore I could even blink!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: And now I lost to you, too!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: That superstrong girl... She had to be Champion\nRank. No doubt about it.

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Rarrr! Raaarrrr! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Do you wanna see my super cool Pokémon\nfigurines?

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Grrryaaa! Craaash! I lost!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Your Pokémon [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0302)]isare super neat! If they ever make\n[VAR 0x1101(00FD,0E0E)]a figure of itfigures of ’em, you bet I’ll collect [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0C01)]ithe whole set!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: It doesn’t matter. ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: It doesn’t matter how old you are if your\nPokémon are strong.

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You’re strong! And young!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: With Pokémon, a child can defeat an adult!\nThat’s what makes it so fun!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Where did you\ncome from? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Oh, you’re from Cabo Poco? I’m from\nMontenevera!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I was representing Montenevera but I still lost...

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The snow in Montenevera is gorgeous! And we\nhave a beautiful concert stage too!\c\nI bet Cabo Poco doesn’t have all that!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Which do you like? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Do you like studying in the classroom? Or do you\nlike adventuring in the wild?

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Well, I can tell you definitely like Pokémon.

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Me, I prefer to stay in my classroom and study!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Hoo hah! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hoo hah! Hoo hah!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I guess just shouting wasn’t enough to win.

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Hoo hah!\nI tried copying the shouts of a martial artist I\r\nlook up to, but I couldn’t win anyway.

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Monsters! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I love Pokémon that are like the monsters\nin movies!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I can’t believe my monster was defeated!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: In the movies, the monsters always lose. But in\nreal life I’d like them to win!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I want to protect\nthis beach. ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hey, did I just catch you littering?! I need to\nbattle you to protect the beach!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Sorry about that... Seems like I was mistaken.

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
This is the Secluded Beach, one of the Ten
Sights of Paldea.\c
It’s not so secluded anymore, what with all the
attention it’s gotten as a tourist location...

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I need your help! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I need a real workout!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Now that was a good workout! I was sweating\na ton!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Pokémon battles are great exercise for the\nTrainers, too! It’s just the best!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: ...Let’s battle.

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: ...You’re strong.

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: That was fun... Bye...

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Where’s Alfornada? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Let’s have a battle. It’ll help me feel less alone\nand lost.

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I lost. This does nothing to help my anxiety.

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Supposedly, I can reach Alfornada if I just follow\nthe road, but...is this even a road...?

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: What a great view! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I wanna get a selfie of me beating you with this\ngorgeous view as a backdrop!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: A selfie of my defeat, huh?

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I wanted a selfie so I could use it for my icon\non my profile!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Focus! Gotta focus! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I lost at the Alfornada Gym so I’m doing some\nmore training.

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Yet another defeat!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
Tulip, the Alfornada Gym Leader, is a skilled
Trainer of Psychic-type Pokémon.\c
My Fighting-type Pokémon didn’t stand
a chance...

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Putting my trained\nlegs to use! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text:
One! Two!
One! Two!\c
I trained using the torturously long staircase in
front of the school!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I wish training my legs also made my Pokémon\nstronger.

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
That staircase in front of the school sure is
ridiculously long, isn’t it?\c
You can catch the student council president
sitting down for a breather from time to time.

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’m so worried! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: A child, out all on your own? Why, you have me\nworried sick! I’ve got to get you back to town!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oh, well, if you’re that strong, I suppose I\nneedn’t worry.

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Watch out for dangerous Pokémon and strange\npeople, OK?

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: This slope is awesome! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: This is an absolute paradise for us hikers!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: It’s like I’m climbing into the sky!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Flat paths are so boring. Just like life, you gotta\nhave peaks and valleys!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Your future is hazy. ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Let me see your future. Let’s see if you’ll make it\nout of this cave!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You’ll be fine wherever you go...

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Alfornada is ahead, after you climb this cave\never upward.\c\nFollow the torches. They will be your guide.

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Where am I? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I was running after Pokémon and...now I’m\ncompletely lost!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Lost my way to victory too...

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: If I really get stumped, I’ll call a Flying Taxi.

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Whew... Just a\nlittle more... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I swore to myself that I’d make my way to town\nwithout riding on my Pokémon.

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: My legs are about to give out, and I’m about to\ngive up...

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I guess it’s a good time for a breather! And I’ve\ngot some sandwiches for my Pokémon!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: This is so much fun! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Treasure hunting is so much fun! And it’ll be even\nmore fun when I beat you!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Losing isn’t fun!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: This Treasure Hunt project is fun, isn’t it?\c\nIt’s a great chance to really reexamine yourself!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Gotta remember\nPokémon types... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Pokémon types are so complicated, don’t\nyou think?

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Not complicated for you, huh?

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: OK, so I get why Water is strong against Fire...\nBut why is Dark strong against Psychic?

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: So much work! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: *huff* *puff*\nIt’s so much work to get to town from here!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I bet I’d have won if I wasn’t so tired.

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I wish they’d give me a bonus for each delivery\nI make to Alfornada.

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Did I see you riding\non a Pokémon? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I didn’t know there was a Pokémon that could\nclimb these steep slopes with a rider...

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I thought I’d trained pretty hard...

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Such a mysterious Pokémon... I’ve never seen\nanything like it!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Behold these muscles! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I built up these muscles by many trips to the gym!\nMy brilliant brawn will surely lead me to victory!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: My massive musculature misled me!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The gym I go to isn’t a Pokémon Gym, you know!\nIt’s a human gym!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: How does today’s\nweather look? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ll tell you why I’m so worried about the weather!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Sandstorms are weather too, you know!\n...I swear! They are!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
The truly frightening thing about a sandstorm is
not the damage it deals...\c
it’s the fact that Rock-type Pokémon get a
Sp. Def boost and become even hardier!

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: ’Scuse me! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Wouldja be so kind as to battle me? As, like,\ncelebration for reaching Alfornada?

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Wait...this isn’t Alfornada?

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: You’re saying Alfornada is beyond Alfornada\nCavern...? I need to climb even more?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Map says it’s around\nhere somewhere... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You wouldn’t happen to know the address for the\nTeam Star Poison crew’s base, would you?

entries.label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I misread the map, and I misread the course of\nthat battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: It seems like Team Star’s Poison crew set up their\nbase across the river.

entries.label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Gotta study hard! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hey, aren’t you a student?! You should be at\nschool!

entries.label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You schooled me!

entries.label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: You should go back to the academy now and\nthen to attend class. You’ll learn a lot!

entries.label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: What colorful trees... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Do you know why these trees have so many\ncolors on them?

entries.label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Waaaaaah! Now I’m all bluuueee!

entries.label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The colorful markings on these trees were\npainted by a Pokémon called Grafaiai.\r\nThat Pokémon is a real artist. Just like me!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Heeey, you wanna\nbuy this? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Oh ho ho! You bought it—my fake out, that is!\nNow it’s battle time!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: That little joke really cost me!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
Did you know that shops will buy your items? But
you’ll only get a quarter what you’d pay for ’em.\c
If you want to make money, sell items like
Nuggets—that’s really all they’re good for!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Ahhh, Steel-type Pokémon! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ll show you how strong and sturdy Steel-type\nPokémon can be!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Did you already know how to get around\nSteel-type Pokémon’s sturdy strength?

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
Steel types don’t have all that many weaknesses,
and they can’t be poisoned!\c
They get KAPOW’ed by Fighting-type moves,
though...plus Fire-type moves melt them down!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: This is Area Three of\nthe East Province! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Area Three of the East Province is a mining belt!\nWe dig, dig, dig for metals!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I see you’re no stranger to hard work!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Maybe this is a good time for me to head back\nto Zapapico and rest up!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: So, about those mines... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Do you think people can go hiking in mines?

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I guess you wouldn’t know, huh?

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: No matter the reason, kids like you should stay\noutta mines! You’re a minor, not a miner!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: My Pokémon!\nIt evooolved! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Want to help my newly evolved Pokémon with\nsome target practice?

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: My Pokémon’s so newly evolved, it doesn’t\nknow how to battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: It’s amazing how Magikarp evolves into Gyarados.\nI wish I could evolve into a Pokémon, too...

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Ptooey! Blech... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: There’s so much sand around here, my mouth’s\ngetting all gritty...

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: What, the battle’s over? I was still spitting\nout sand...

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Even sandstorms won’t give you any trouble if\nyou’ve got Safety Goggles in hand!\r\nThe sand will still get in your mouth though!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Harsh landscapes\nare the best! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Harsh landscapes like this are the best for\ngood-quality training!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: So harsh!!!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: What would happen if I trained on a tropical\nbeach instead? Would it be...not very effective?

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Gosh, it was amazing! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Oh my gosh, I saw something amazing! Wanna\nknow what it was?

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I saw an amaaazing Pokémon right here!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
A huuuge Pokémon like one of those big towers
in Levincia came right out of the ground!\c
It looked just like the giant Diglett statues they
have in some other region!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Ah, sad songs... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Are you a fan of sad songs? Or not so much?\nMy personal opinion is...they’re OK, I guess!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: It’s a sad, sad loss in a sad, sad world. ♪\nTra la la laaa. ♪

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Just a theory of mine, but I think cheery people\ntend to be more fond of sad songs!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Tick-tock-tick-tock. ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Come on! Let’s have a battle of luck!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Is your luck good? Or is mine just bad?

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Metronome is a move that leaves everything to\nluck! So it wasn’t my skill that failed me.

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Let’s talk about me! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hey! Don’t you think I’m awful cute?

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I wish you’d show a little more respect for my\ncuteness.

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Maybe I should have spent more time making my\nPokémon really cute?

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’ll see if you’re worthy. ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Are you a student, child? Allow me to test your\nabilities!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: That was conceited of me...

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: My apologies. You were the superior Trainer.

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: You got moxie, kid? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I want to battle someone with serious moxie! Are\nyou that someone?

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You outmoxied me!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: That was the best battle I’ve had in a while!\nThanks for talking to me, kid!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Everything here’s\nso rugged... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Seems rough and rugged places like this attract\na lot of hardy Pokémon, huh?

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Wow! The Trainers are hardy, too!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: If I want to find soft, fluffy Pokémon, should I\nlook in a flower meadow or something?

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Hey! Hold up,\nwould you? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Tagtree Thicket up ahead isn’t safe—you’ll run\ninto a bunch of delinquents.

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Wow, you’re strong. I guess you didn’t need\nmy advice!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: They’re from a group called Team Star? People\nsay they’re delinquents, right? Not that they’ve\r\ndone anything to me, mind you, but still...

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: What Pokémon do\nyou think I’ll use? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Did you talk to me because you thought I’d use\nDragon-type Pokémon?

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You were right! It’s dragons all the way!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Maybe this outfit isn’t doing me any good.\nEveryone can tell which type I’ll be using...

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Any day now! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: My baby is due any day now! I gotta get serious!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I wish I could’ve gotten a bit more serious in\nthat battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: When my kid is old enough, I’ll be sure to send\nthem to the same school you go to!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: According to my\ncalculations... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I calculated it all, and I knew the likelihood you’d\ncome talk to me was 100 percent!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I failed to calculate my chances of winning...

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Do you have lessons with Ms. Tyme?\nThey’re really fun if you love math!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: He loves me...\nHe loves me not... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: If I beat you, I’m gonna tell my crush how I feel!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I lost! Oh, thank goodness!

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: At this rate, I’ll always be holding back on\nmaking any decisive moves...

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: In cold places\nlike this... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: In cold places like this, my life gets a bit easier!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Only my deliveries get easier, you know!\nBattling’s as tough as always!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The food I’m delivering doesn’t spoil when it’s\ncold out. For once, I’m not rushed off my feet!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Ah... Aaah! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: ACHOOOOOOOOO!!!\nUm... That was my battle cry!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Choo...

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I’m trying to get to the Glaseado Gym, but boy\nis it cold here!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Here’s the thing\nabout Paldea... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Paldea has all sorts of different climates,\ndepending on where you go!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Brrrrrr!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: It’s so cold in this area! Anyone without warm\nwinter clothes is gonna have a tough time.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The snow’s\na-fallin’ down! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hey there! Want me ta tell ya the best thing\n’bout the snowy peaks?

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Yer strong, that’s fer sure...

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: It’s Ice-type Pokémon, o’ course! There’s tons\nof ’em up in the snow!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I gotta get to\nthat concert! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I heard that Ryme, the world-famous rapper, is\nhaving a concert over in Montenevera!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I’m gonna miss the concert!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Don’t tell me...Montenevera is on the OTHER\nside of the mountain?

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: You heard of the\nSnow Slope Run? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I traveled a long way to get here so I could\ntry my hand at the Snow Slope Run.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Battling is also a slippery slope.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: For my Treasure Hunt, I’m gonna get the world\nrecord in the Snow Slope Run! Ehehehe...

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Oh, my dear Grusha... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Grusha used to be a pro snowboarder, you know.\nI came here to meet him, but now I’m lost!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Grushaaa! Where are yooouuu?

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I suppose if I head toward the mountain peak, I’ll\neventually spot the Glaseado Gym, where my\r\ndear Grusha awaits me...

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I sense a strong aura... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Your Pokémon seem[VAR 0x1101(00FD,0001)]s really strong! I wanna\nbattle [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0402)]itthem!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: So I was right!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: If you made it all the way out here, you’ve gotta\nbe strong for sure.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Woo-hoo! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I was born up north, so I get excited when I\ncome to cold places like this.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You left me out in the cold!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: It’s amazing what a difference it makes when you\nprotect your head and ears against the cold!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: A little more\nrespect, please? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hey, you! You’re not treatin’ the mountain with\nthe respect it deserves!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Just a little bit is all I’m askin’...

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: You can never be overprepared for a hike! Bring\nall the items you can carry—and then some!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Oh! It’s someone\nfrom school... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: It’s kind of embarrassing bumping into your\nschoolmates outside of school, huh?

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I lost... Now I’m even more embarrassed.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I hate running into people I know when I’m out\nand about. It’s weird, I know.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Thick Fat is\nwhere it’s at! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: My protective layer of fat keeps me nice and\ntoasty even out in the cold!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Being nice and toasty didn’t help me win...

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Pokémon with the Thick Fat Ability receive less\ndamage from Fire- and Ice-type moves!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: This is the perfect\nplace to train! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I come to harsh environments like this to train my\nbody and soul. That’s just my style!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: My Pokémon and I were too busy hunkering\ndown against the cold.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
The body temperatures of most Dragon types
vary greatly with their environment.\c
That’s why they don’t handle ice and snow all
that well.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: What is art? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: What is art? I...I don’t even know anymore.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: That last move of yours was pure art!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I feel motivation welling up inside me! Cheers for\nthe battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Careful there,\nyoung one. ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You ought to be careful. There’s no shortage of\nstrong Trainers in these parts.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I suppose none of the other Trainers were as\nstrong as you.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: A weak Trainer could never make it up here.\nI apologize for judging you prematurely.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’ll use the snow! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m going to use snow to make art! That’s why I\ncame up here!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oh nooo! I just realized something!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Any art that I make out of snow is going to melt\nas soon as I take it with me off this mountain!\r\nArgh! Back to square one.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Time to whip out\nmy camera app! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ll take an awesome video of this battle with my\ncamera app! It’s gonna blow up everyone’s feeds!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I...I can’t post this.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: My posts never get any likes or comments. Is it\nbecause I don’t have any followers?
