entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Clear your mind... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: If you clear your mind of all worldly thoughts,\neven fire will feel cool!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Brrrrrr... C-c-clear y-y-your m-m-mind...

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Snow still feels cold even if you clear your mind!\nWhat gives?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: YODEL-AY-HEE-HOOO! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: YODEL-AY-HEE-HOOO!\nWah! Who are you?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: No, really! Who ARE you?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I like how you can “yodel-ay-hee-hoo” up here\nand get a “yodel-ay-hee-hoo” right back!\r\nWonder who’s doing the responding.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I wanna be a hiker! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hikers are great! So strong and free and cool!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Being strong and free is tough...

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Mountains are dangerous, huh? Maybe I’ll head\nto the forests instead!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: White snow all around... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: White snow all around... ♪\nI cross paths with a schoolkid... ♪\r\nArgh, I can’t come up with the last line!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: A bitter defeat... ♪

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I came here to compose haiku, but only wintry\nverses are springing to mind.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: KAPOW! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: All opponents will meet my fists of fury!\nKAPOW! KABLAM!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Kapow... Ka...kablam...\nOwie. That hurts.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Guess it doesn’t matter how much I train my fists\nof fury—they’re no good in Pokémon battles.

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Mi-mi-miiiiii! ♪\nMa-ma-maaa! ♪ ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Glaseado Mountain has such nice, fresh air!\nI can sing so well up here!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: That’s all from me-me-me-meeeeee! ♪\n...Oh! I struck that note beautifully!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I might cause an avalanche if I sing too\nloudly, huh?

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: ’Sup! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: ’Sup! Wild Bull Transport, at your service!\nWhat say we have a quick battle?

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Errr! Guess I wasn’t wild enough!

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Wild Bull Transport has Tauros as our mascot!\nNeed goods delivered? Our Tauros-strength\r\nmuscles will get it there!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Oh! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ve seen you around school! You’re that new\ntransfer student, aren’t you?

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: This new kid’s really shaking things up...

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: You’re a strong one, new kid! We’re not in the\nsame year, but I’ll see you around the academy!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Those pillars of light... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Have you ever seen one of those pillars of light?\nYou can spot them even from far away!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Hrrrmmm... Too bright!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: If you check out pillars of light, you can join\nTera Raid Battles and catch Tera Pokémon!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: In Area One of the\nWest Province... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Wind power is big here in Area One of the\nWest Province.

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I forgot that kids have unlimited energy.

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Wind, hydroelectric, geothermal—all sorts of\nenergy can be generated from nature.

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_KARATE_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Once I master the\nmartial arts... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_KARATE_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Once I master the martial arts...what am I\nsupposed to do afterward?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_KARATE_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I never said I already mastered them!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_KARATE_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: What to do after mastering the martial arts...\nGuess I’ll cross that bridge when I come to it!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I wonder where the shrine is that has the\n“Ruin Us” Pokémon sealed inside?

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I read in a book that the Ruin Us Pokémon\nwas sealed in a shrine around here! But, uh...\r\nwhat’s a “Ruin Us” Pokémon?

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Area One of the West Province has a lotta wind!\nWhoosh whoosh whoooooosh!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Looking at a big windmill too long makes\nme dizzy!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Hey there! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hey there! Hey! I’m hitchhiking! Can I catch a\nride on your Pokémon?

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: S-sorry I asked!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: It’s easy to get places using the Flying Taxi, but\nthat takes all the fun out of traveling!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: If I win... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: If I win, you’ve gotta buy my CD!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: What? No one buys CDs anymore?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I guess that’s why I can’t sell my CDs. Everybody\nhas some kind of subscription service!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Looking for research\nparticipants! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Aha! My hypothesis was correct! People in this\nregion talk to each other to start battles!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I guess it’s Paldean culture to approach other\nTrainers and talk to them to engage in battles.

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Did you know that there are regions where\nyou have to battle if you make eye contact?

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I hope I don’t fall... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Ahhhhhh! You scared me! What?! A battle?!\nY-yeah, OK! Sure!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I’m glad that scare didn’t make me fall.

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
Even if you fall from high up, your Rotom Phone
will save you.\c
If you can’t get back to where you fell from, just
call a Flying Taxi using your map app!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I won’t lose! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I won’t lose! In terms of being energetic, anyway!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I’m still more energetic than you!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: For kids like me, being energetic is just a part of\nwho we are!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The area up ahead\nis dangerous! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: The area up ahead is dangerous! The Pokémon\nthere are suuuper strong!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: It was YOU I should have been scared of!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The cave up ahead has lots of scary Pokémon!\nIf they’re too strong to handle, you should turn\r\naround and come back.

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I started out from\nthe west gate! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hey! I started out from the west gate\nof Mesagoza!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Did you start out from the west gate too?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Starting from the west side puts you closer to the\nGyms in Cortondo and Cascarrafa!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DELIVERER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Is this for you? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DELIVERER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Are you the one who ordered a pizza to be\ndelivered out here?

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DELIVERER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Just a passerby, huh?

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DELIVERER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I should’ve listened better when they told me\nwhere to deliver this pizza...

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Just call a\nFlying Taxi! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Are you a Pokémon Trainer? Flying Taxi fees are\nwaived for Trainers.

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You’re most definitely a Trainer, all right!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The Pokémon League pays the Flying Taxi fares\nfor all Trainers, so take all the rides you like.

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: So THAT’S a desert... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ve always dreamed of seeing a desert with my\nown eyes.

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You’re full of energy, huh? Just like the desert.

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I’m so glad I had the courage to enroll in the\nacademy. It let me have experiences like this one!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I can’t even get close... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I want to get to the peak, but I can’t even\nget close.

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You’re even wilder than the rolling boulders!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I wonder if I could get up to the peak riding on a\nPokémon if I just avoided the boulders?

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TANPAN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Team Star... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TANPAN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Watch out for Team Star. They have a real unique\nway of battling.

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TANPAN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You’re pretty unique yourself!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TANPAN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I hear Team Star lets their Pokémon call the shots\nagainst their opponents using Auto Battles!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MANIA_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MANIA_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MANIA_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MANIA_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Hey! Let’s talk! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Getting to interact with the locals wherever you\ngo is one of the best parts of traveling.

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: W-wow! You’re quite the character!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Kids from Paldea are pretty strong, huh?! I hope\nI brought enough Potions...

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Guess what’s in\nmy backpack? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Inside my backpack, I have...Pokémon!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Ahhh... I even packed up my best Pokémon!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I keep all sorts of special stuff in my backpack!\nWhat do you keep in yours?

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_KARATE_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Fighting types\nare the best! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_KARATE_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Black Belts just HAVE to choose Fighting-type\nPokémon!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_KARATE_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Now that was a tough fight!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_KARATE_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
We Black Belts love our Fighting-type Pokémon,
you know!\c
So don’t come at us with Psychic- or Flying-types
or anything like that!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: It was carryin’ a coin! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m tryin’a find a widdle Pokémon carryin’ a coin!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I’m tryin’ so hard! But I can’t find it! I just stare\ninto the tall grass...

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: That widdle coin Pokémon runs away fast! You\ncan’t catch it, but it drops a coin if you find it!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: That barricade... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: That barricade over there is part of a Team Star\nbase. Team Star is trouble, so battle me instead!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I guess I couldn’t trick you even with such a slick\nbattle invitation...

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The boss of Team Star’s Dark crew has a real\nmean look in his eyes.

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: A lovely prize! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I want a lovely prize! Let’s battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Awww. This doesn’t add to my win count!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: One of the League staffers at the Pokémon\nCenter told me we could get lovely prizes if we\r\nwin battles against a lot of other Trainers.

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DELIVERER_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’m just no good... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DELIVERER_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Ahhh! I’m just no good! No good at all!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DELIVERER_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: See? I told you!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DELIVERER_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I’m no good as a courier. I always skip out on\nwork to battle. That’s bad, isn’t it?

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Brand-spankin’ new! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m a brand-spankin’ new Dragon Tamer! I’ll rawr\nat ya with my dragon power!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Aren’t Dragon-types supposed to be strong?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I guess it’s ME that’s weak, not my Pokémon! I’ll\nwork hard to get stronger!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: TMs! Wooo! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ve taught my Pokémon all sorts of strong moves\nusing TMs, you know!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I need to make even stronger TMs!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: TMs are great because you can teach Pokémon\nmoves they couldn’t learn otherwise.

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Casseroya! Casseroya! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hey! What does Casseroya mean? That’s all I can\nthink about recently!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Wait! I know! Maybe it’s a royal casserole?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: By the way, Casseroya Lake is to the north—but\nyou won’t get very far if you can’t swim!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: To the west... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: There’s a town to the west! But there’s an\nopponent right in front of you!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You’re strong regardless of what direction you’re\nheaded, huh?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The market town of Porto Marinada lies to the\nwest! By the way, west is the direction marked in\r\nyellow on the map app.

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: So strong! So rare! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You want to see my strong and rare Pokémon,\ndon’t you? DON’T YOU?

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: So strong! So wonderful!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I hear there are Pokémon out there with different\ncoloration than other members of their species.\r\nI sure would like to see one of those someday!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Natuuure! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Let’s have a battle out here surrounded by all this\nsoothing nature!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Well, that wasn’t very soothing...

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I’m gonna have a picnic at all the spots in Paldea\nwith good views.

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Can you help me? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: If I win, can you help me by making my deliveries\nin my stead?

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I knew that wouldn’t work!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I guess this loss was the motivation I needed!\nTime to get back to work!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I want... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I want power!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Your power! It’s overwhelming!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: How did you get so powerful?

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Heeelp! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Heeelp! My hand throws Poké Balls all on its own!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Guess I picked the wrong opponent. Hmph!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I gotta get ready for the next person, so you go\naway, OK? Go!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Top spot! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Mountains are a top spot in my book...because\nthey’re so high up! Get it?

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I lost! I did, did I?

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Phrases like “top spot” are called palindromes!\nThey read the same forwards and backwards!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I prefer the indoors! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I prefer the indoors, but I came here to see this\namazing sight.

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: What an amazing sight!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
This place is called Colonnade Hollow. It’s one of
the Ten Sights of Paldea.\c
I’m going to research how the area came to be
shaped this way!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Hey! Do you know... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hey! Do you know... Do you know how strong\nI am?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I was just a big fish in a small pond...but you\nshowed me what the ocean is like!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: There are people more talented than me all over\nthis great big world of ours, huh?

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The ocean is so vast... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Let’s have a battle here with a refreshing\nocean view!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: What? This isn’t the ocean? It’s a lake?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: My map app says this body of water is a lake...\nAren’t lakes basically just tiny oceans?

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: She’s so popular! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Have you heard of the superpopular streamer\nnamed Iono?

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Ah! I was going to buy merch with that money!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Iono’s a streamer and a Gym Leader, too! She’s\nalso super cute! You should watch her stuff.

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Welcome! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Welcome to the outdoor café! Our special today\nis the taste of defeat—coming right up!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Ah... so THIS is what defeat tastes like!

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Defeat doesn’t taste so bad once you get used\nto it. An acquired taste, I suppose?

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: My Pokémon\nis the cutest! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: My Pokémon is obviously the cutest, but my\nfriends just don’t get it!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I don’t mind losing, as long as I got to convey to\nyou how cute Dedenne is!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Some people don’t like Dedenne because it\nsteals electricity. But honestly, being a li’l thief\r\njust makes it even cuter...

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: You been to Medali? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Medali’s famous Treasure Eatery gets a one-star\nreview from me!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Your battle skill is five stars!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I heard you can change your Pokémon’s Tera\nType at the Treasure Eatery, but that stubborn\r\nchef wouldn’t even give me the time of day!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Behold my illusions! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I will show you the illusion of the century!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You saw right through my illusions!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Zorua’s always disguised as some other Pokémon.\nIt’s really hard to find!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Where’s the\nbattle court...? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I need to make a delivery to Medali’s\nbattle court!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I can’t find my destination OR my way to victory...

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Medali has a Gym, but I don’t see a battle\ncourt anywhere!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Work, work, work... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Right! I’ve made up my mind!\nI’ll go to work if I win this battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Woooooo! I lost, so I guess I’m taking today off!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Just to be clear, I didn’t lose just so I could take\nthe day off, OK? I would never do that.

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: When two\nTrainers meet... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: A battle is unavoidable when two Trainers meet!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Where there’s a victor, there’s also a loser.

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Battling you reminded me of how I used to be—\npicking fights with everyone I came across.

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The ice cream vendor... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: The ice cream vendor at Medali was selling\nsomething mighty strange.

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: That wasn’t very sweet of you!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I didn’t know modern ice cream vendors had such\nsalty-sweet ice cream!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Hee hee hee! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hee hee hee! I’m kinda the main attraction at\nmy café!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Hey! Don’t steal my appeal!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I’m the adorable battling barista! Hope to see\nyou at the café sometime!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: My Pokémon is\nobviously the cutest! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Wanna know the cutest Pokémon of them all?\n’Cause I’m gonna tell you!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Allow me to illustrate for you the many qualities\nthat make Pawmo such a cute— Wait, I lost?

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
OK, so, what makes Pawmo so cute is how it
hustles its little heart to keep up when you’ve got
it walking around with you—and ohmygosh,
I even heard that if you walk with it enough,
it might even evolve, and I just absolutely
CANNOT EVEN with how cute it is! Hee hee!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Could you be...? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Could you be...what I’m here to clean up?

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You wiped the floor with me...

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: My mistake—I took you for someone else.\nNow go away and don’t talk to me.

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: If I had to pick... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: If I had to pick between the hike up a mountain\nand the hike down...the hike down’s more fun!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I took a steep fall!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: When two people on a mountain trail pass each\nother, the one going up has the right of way!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: We’ve got to\nsynergize! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: We’ve got to synergize across all metrics! Let’s\npivot and take this offline.

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: We need to circle back on this...

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: You really leveraged your core competencies.\nI need to drill down on improving...

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Talk to me! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hey, you talked to me! Thanks. Now let’s battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Wow, you’re bold!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I guess you wouldn’t have come talk to me if you\nweren’t confident in your battle skills...

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I think my Pokémon\nis the cutest. ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You seem to have a discerning eye. Have a look\nat the cutest Pokémon there is!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Ah, how utterly adorable Bergmite looks when\nit’s defeated...

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
It’s plain as day that Bergmite’s the cutest of all,
but my friends just don’t see it.\c
Anyway, you can find Bergmite on Glaseado
Mountain. You ought to catch one for yourself!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: It’s gotta be nearby... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: They say there’s a tunnel around here that leads\ninto the Great Crater of Paldea!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Looks like my search is getting cut short!

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
I’ve also heard there’s some research facility near
the entrance of the Great Crater of Paldea...\c
They say it’s fallen into disuse, but...ooh, I want
to find it so bad! I just want to see what’s there!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I am a Dragon Tamer... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: We Dragon Tamers are wielders of dragon\nPokémon!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: It seems you are even better at wielding your\npreferred Pokémon than I am.

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Dragons are a challenge to raise, but they have\nfew weaknesses. If you can raise them to be\r\nstrong enough, victory will be yours.

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I don’t wanna... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I don’t wanna do my job! No!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Waaaaaahhh! You meaniehead!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
I’ve actually been having a really tough time at
work lately, but that sure helped!\c
There’s nothing like letting yourself act childish
when you’re feeling overwhelmed!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Astounding! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Astounding! You have a Tera Orb, do you?

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: How dazzling!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Tera Orbs are quite precious, so only the best\nstudents and teachers are allowed to have them.

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Wahaha! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Wahaha! I’m out here enjoying my youth on my\nTreasure Hunt!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Wahaha! Nothing will stop my enjoyment!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The only way to win in life is to enjoy it!\nIt’s a waste to think you should or shouldn’t\r\ndo something simply because of your age!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I want to be\nlike the wind... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I want to be like the wind and travel across the\nwhole wide world!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Why are the winds of fate always blowing\nagainst me?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I saw this floaty Pokémon wafting along on the\nbreeze nearby!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: “Beep-beep-beep” goes the\ncabbie, all through the sky ♪ ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Gah! Where’d you come from?! I was singing to\nmyself thinking there was no one around!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I couldn’t even win, I was so embarrassed...

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I was trying to think up a jingle to use on our\ncommercials for the Flying Taxi...\r\n“All through the sky...” ♪

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I just can’t decide! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I just can’t decide! What do you think?\c\nShould I go to Artazon to experience real art?\nOr Levincia for big-city thrills?

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I guess I should have been worrying more about\nwhich move to use in battle...

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Maybe I’ll go experience the art in Artazon...\nThere are a bunch of different art installations\r\non display all over the town.

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: It’s just no good... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: It’s just no good! I...I can’t control my power!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Phew! Thanks for helping me tamp down my\npower like that! It can be pretty overwhelming!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: My power is too great for my own good.\nSometimes it runs amok, and I just defeat every\r\nTrainer I meet. Glad that didn’t happen to you!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: What should I throw...? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Pop quiz! What should I throw if I want to start\na battle?

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Well, that result sure threw me!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: It’s so nice how you can just throw a Poké Ball\ncontaining one of your Pokémon at a wild\r\nPokémon to dive right into a battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’ll stick with it! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ll show you! I’m tenacious, and I’ll stick it out\nno matter how hard the battle gets!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Even though you’ve beat me, I still won’t give up!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Attacking isn’t the only way to be strong! There\nare all kinds of moves that help you stick it out!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: My Pokémon! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: My Pokémon! And your Pokémon! What’s so\ndifferent about them?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: E-everything’s different!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Individual Pokémon have different individual\nstrengths, even if they’re the same species.

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: All right! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: All right! Just one bout! This’ll be a good\nwarm-up before I head to the work site!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: That didn’t warm me up at all...

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: You’re real strong, kid! What do you do to\nwarm up?

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Enjoying your day off? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Enjoying your day off? ’Cause I am!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Goodness, you’re strong!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I finally took some time off work, but I just\ncouldn’t leave my cleaning supplies behind...\r\nMaybe I work too much...

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Oh-ho-ho-ho-ho-hooo! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Oh-ho-ho-ho-ho-hooo! Get ready to see a real\nchef at work!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Now why’d you go and do that?! I just wanted to\nmake some sandwiches for a picnic!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: When your Pokémon are feeling rough after\nbattling, feed them sandwiches to perk them up.

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Your bill... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: If you lose to me, your bill will be 1,000,000!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Wait, I got the math wrong!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I-I was only kidding before! You didn’t really\nexpect me to pay you THAT much, did you?

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Squawkabilly! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: What powers our Flying Taxis? Squawkabilly’s\nplucky spirit!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: What spirit! I love it!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Did you know that wild Squawkabilly of the same\ncolor tend to flock together?

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: My map keeps spinning! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: The map app in my phone keeps spinning!\nMake it stop!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I’m in a real downward spiral now!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
So you can set your map so that north is always
at the top, can you?\c
As you get up in years like me, figuring out these
smartphones can make you feel awful dumb!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: You! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I saw you at the school, talking so familiarly with\nDirector Clavell!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oh, sweet Clavell, what do you see in this\nne’er-do-well...

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Director Clavell has such a gentle and refined\ndemeanor. He’s simply lovely...

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: To be a waiter... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: To be a waiter is to wait. I’ll wait for the perfect\nmoment to take care of you!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: N-now wait just a moment!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: My battle strategy hinges on sometimes waiting\nfor my opponent to land a blow before I do.\r\nBut sometimes I lose if I wait too long...

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Sunflora! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Sunflora flood the floral fiefdom in formation!\nSunflora flood the floral fiefdom in formation!\r\nI made up my own tongue twister!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Sunflora flood the flooof—\nDah! No! I messed up!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Sunflora flood the floral fiefdom in formation! I\nmade my tongue twister ’cause I love Sunflora.\c\nThe Gym Test in Artazon was right up my alley!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: My reason for living! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: My work is my reason for living! It’s something\nthat’s worth doing, and it gives me purpose!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Well, since I lost, I guess I’ll be getting back to\nwork now!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
If you do what you love for work, then at least
you know you’ll enjoy that part of your life!\c
It won’t be all fun and games, but it’s still better
than a kick in the teeth!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The Fire crew... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Did you know Team Star’s Fire crew has a base\nnear here?

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You’re on fire!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The boss of the Fire crew is this girl named Mela.\nShe talks real tough and scares me silly!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The Great Crater\nof Paldea... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Have you been to the Great Crater of Paldea?

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: What! You beat me?! My confidence is cratering!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: They say that there’s this mysterious place called\nArea Zero inside the Great Crater of Paldea—\r\nand that great treasures sleep within it!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I wanna be\nnumber one! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I wanna be number one! I’m gonna be\nthe strongest!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I guess maybe we can share being number one!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Outta all the Champions, there’s a number-one\nstrongest one called the Top Champion!\r\nBoy, that’s what I wanna be someday!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Y’know what? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Y’know what? I wanna become real strong.\nJus’ like Missy Nemona is!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: G-gotta be like Missy Nemona!

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: *sniffle* O-oh... *sniffle* Thanks for the battle...\c\nDoes Missy Nemona cry when she loses?\nI...I guess I’ve gotta be...t-tough...

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Are you the client...? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Are you the client? Did you manage to bring the,\nah, sample that I contacted you about?

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I-I’m pretty sure you aren’t my client! Please!\nDon’t make me battle any more!

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Sh-shove off, won’t you! Before anyone sees!\nI’m supposed to meet someone here who said\r\nthey’d show me some super cute Pokémon!

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: That was one\ntasty-looking Pokémon. ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I don’t know how to describe it, but it’s...like...\nman, that Pokémon I saw! It looked delicious!

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I don’t know how to put this, but...like...thanks\nfor the battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
So this really tasty-looking Pokémon, right? It was
just going along, then this other huge Pokémon
went and, like, gulped it right down!\c
I guess that’s what happens when you look so
darn tasty. You get eaten, that’s what.

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’ve heard the rumors... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ve heard the rumors of a Pokémon in these\nlands—one known as the False Dragon Titan!

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: But what is this False Dragon?! What is real?!\nWhat is false?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Could it be that the False Dragon Titan isn’t a\nreal dragon at all? But...but...\c\nWhat’s even the point if it’s not a real dragon?

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Take a picture for\nme, would you? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m about to beat you. It’d be great if you could\ntake a commemorative photo for me when I do!

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I don’t need a photo to commemorate losing!

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Um, sorry if I was a bit over the top just then...\c\nAll this wide-open space really gives the ol’\nemotions room to run wild!

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Hoooh! Haaah! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hoooh! Haaah!\nHoooh! Haaah!\r\nYes, the air out here truly is fine! Breathe deep!

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Why, I detect a hint of a salt on the breeze!

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The air out here is the best of any I’ve had. I’d\nhappily live on it all my remaining days!

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Oooh! Ow-ow-ow! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I spent too long crouched down sneaking through\nthe tall grass—now my back is killing me!

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I wonder if I could’ve won if my back wasn’t\nacting up like this...

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: You can get close to wild Pokémon without them\nnoticing you if you crouch down nice and low.\r\nBut your back might regret it...

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Wow, all the\nway out here? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You’ve sure put in some effort, coming all the\nway out here on your own little legs.

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Those little legs hold up some real great skills!

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
There aren’t any towns or Pokémon Centers or
anything around these parts.\c
If you get tired, don’t try to tough it out! Give a
Flying Taxi a call!

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: What if I put\nthe camera here? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m actually a singer, see. I came out here to\nscout a location for my next music video.

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I got beat by some...some NOBODY?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: That’s it! We’re definitely not filming here!\c\nI can’t even stand here without remembering that\nI lost a battle to someone like you!

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The greatest view of all... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m traveling the expanse of Paldea in search of\nthe greatest view of all.

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I wonder how the world looks in your eyes?

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I thought I might have finally found the greatest\nview of all here, but it seems I was wrong...\r\nI think there are still greater sights to aspire to!

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Mushroom! Mushroom! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Mushroom! Mushroom? MushROOOOOOM!

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oh! My word! Please forgive me! I was quite\ncaught up in my own world there for a moment...

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I was playing with the adorable little mushroom\nPokémon and lost all track of where I was!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: *pant pant* ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I was...climbing this rock face...so I’m...outta\nbreath...but my team’s...fine!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Phew... Hah!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: If only I could...ride a Pokémon and let it do the\nclimbing...

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: If I could only\ncross the sea... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Lend me a Pokémon that can take me across\nthe sea!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Looks like I’m sunk!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: If only there was some Pokémon I could ride over\nthe sea, I could be sitting and sipping something\r\non a sandy beach right now!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Been out east? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: One of Team Star’s bases is off to the east of\nhere. So scary!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I guess if I was as strong as you, I wouldn’t need\nto be scared, even of Team Star!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Team Star’s Fighting crew has a base off to the\neast of here, and their boss is super scary...\r\nTh-that grim look she’s always got—brrr!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Quite the traveler,\naren’t you? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You’ve come a good long way since setting out\nfrom the academy, haven’t you?

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Yes, I could feel precisely how much experience\nyou’ve gained on your travels.

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
You and I have both walked the same distance,
and yet I still lost to you.\c
I suppose that the paths you’ve chosen must have
been richer in what they offered.

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: This...is...ridiculous! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: So ridiculous! I was doing the Snow Slope Run on\nGlaseado Mountain and ended up...here!\r\nWhere the heck is “here” anyway?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Whoa! Your Pokémon are ridiculously strong!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I wasn’t actually planning to come here, but this\nended up pretty fun, too! Huh!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Yes! At last! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hey! Hey, you there! You’re mine! Once I defeat\nyou, you’ll be another “feather in my cap”!\r\nBut what does that even mean?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Looks like we may never know!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Sure, if you just looked up the phrase, you could\nfind out in a sec what it means...but it’s fun\r\nmaking people stop and wonder!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Sandwiches... Yes... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Apparently this one earl thought up sandwiches\nbecause he wanted to be able to eat while\r\nkeeping a hand free to play games!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I guess Pokémon battling isn’t really a game...\nSeems I can’t pull it off one-handed!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I love learning the history of things. I always ace\nall my history tests, too.

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I am the\ndragon’s wings! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I am the eldest of three sisters, the one who’s\nclaimed the dragon’s wings! I’ll blast you away!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: It seems I failed to take flight...

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Dragons may be slow to grow, but if you put the\ntime into raising one, they’re fearsomely strong!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I am the\ndragon’s breath! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I am the second of three sisters, the one who’s\nclaimed the dragon’s breath! I’ll blow you away!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You left me no time to catch my breath...

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Dragons are weak to Ice-type moves, and they\nhave a hard time taking on cute little fairies, too.

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I am the\ndragon’s tail! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I am the youngest of three sisters, the one who’s\nclaimed the dragon’s tail! And I’ll send you flying!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I might have to turn tail and run!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: It was my big sister who thought up this whole\nthing about us being different parts of a dragon...\r\nHonestly, I find it all a bit embarrassing.

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_OL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: So free! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_OL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m no longer bound by the office! The whole\nwide world is my office now!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_OL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I think it’s time I clock out for the day!

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_OL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Hmmm. If the whole world is my office...does that\nmean I never actually leave work?

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Bamboo shoots pop-\npop-popping up! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I came out hunting for bamboo shoots, but I\nguess I could forage for battles while I’m at it!

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Shoot, I was so busy thinking about bamboo\nthat I didn’t focus on the battle...

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Big Bamboo Shoots are quite valuable, so you\ncan sell them at shops for a tidy profit!

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Unbelievable! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Gosh, I feel like a buffoon! I thought the thing\nI saw was just a mushroom, but it was ALIVE!

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I guess there really are fungus among us!

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The Mushroom Pokémon Foongus is poisonous\ntoo, so be careful around it!

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: These falls... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: These falls are said to be quite famous. I’ll help\ncommemorate your visit with a fine battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I got so worked up the sweat was pouring down\nmy back like a cascade!

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: They’re called the Fury Falls...but I wonder what’s\ngot them so angry?

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Pro...wrestling? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You young’uns call that flashy sport pro wrestling,\nright? Is it popular among your set these days?

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: It seems you are a pro at Pokémon battles.

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
I saw a student up ahead who was all done up in
the most outrageous pro wrestling outfit.\c
It was absolutely splendid! I wonder if she would
let me join her in her shenanigans?

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Hyah! Rah! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I got my black belt through an online course!

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Wait, this stuff is way harder in real life?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Nowadays you can do everything online! It’s a\nnew age of remote learning!

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’ll. Show. YOU! ♥  ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m super strong! I’ll. Show. YOU! ♥

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You. Beat. ME! ♥

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: You’re super strong! You’re. The. BEST! ♥

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: A backpacker’s\nonly weakness! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: A backpacker’s only weakness is Steel-type\nmoves!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Darn, you saw through my lie?

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: My real weakness is Reality-type moves! I just\nwant to get away from reality! Ahaha...hah...

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The academy\nhas a secret! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: If you can defeat me, I’ll tell you the academy’s\nbig secret!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I lost? Then I guess I’ve got no choice but to spill\nthe beans...

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
The academy had some kind of big brouhaha
back when I first enrolled.\c
All the teachers at the time quit. The teachers
we’ve got now were all hired after that.

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’m sick of it! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m just so sick of research! Help distract me so\nI can forget about my work for a while!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: What is your training method? And what do you\nfeed your team? Are their moves from TMs?

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Even when I want to stop questioning everything,\nI can’t! I guess this is why I’m a scientist.

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I am strong. ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I am strong. And so I battle.

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You...are strong!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I am strong. You are stronger. That is all there is\nto it, really.

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Delivery! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m a courier...fan! I just like to dress up like this!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Please sign here!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Couriers have a pretty passionate fan base! It may\nbe a niche interest, but we’re out there!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: That’s right... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: That’s right...I’m totally lost!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You’re not lost at all, are you?! Don’t tell me...\nYou actually WANTED to come out here?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I was trying to catch a Pokémon, followed it all\nthe way out here...and ended up getting lost!\r\nI think I’ll call a Flying Taxi!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: This is my spot! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: This is my spot! If you want to camp, go find a\nspot of your own!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oh, are you just here for a hike? Not to camp?

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Food always tastes better up in the mountains,\ndoesn’t it? I guess exhaustion is the best spice!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Such a shame... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: It was such a shame, what happened to Grusha.\nThat accident ruined his snowboarding career!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Ah, sorry for going on about old news! I suppose\nthat all must have been before your time.

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
Grusha was once the second best snowboarder
in all the world...\c
But he was injured in an accident—badly enough
that he was forced to retire from the sport.

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I understand! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I understand! Here! In this freezing land!\nI’ve finally come to understand a great truth!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Yes, you’ve made me understand it all too well!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I understand now that training in freezing places\nisn’t efficient! You don’t get strong—just sick!\r\nAh-ah-ah-CHOOO!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: That uniform... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: That uniform looks really good on you! Do you\nthink it would look good on me too?

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I-is that a no?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Seeing you out having adventures in your uniform\nreminded me of my own school days, that’s all...

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I need more data! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ve decided my research subject for the day!\nAllow me to collect some data from YOU!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Why can’t I seem to capture your data?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I couldn’t collect any data at all! Is something\nwrong with my equipment?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Ow! Ow! Ow! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I twisted my ankle climbing over some rocks.\nMaybe a battle will distract me from the pain!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I forgot about my ankle, but now my pride hurts!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Isn’t it handy how Pokémon can go and heal\nthemselves of minor injuries or status conditions\r\nif they’re holding a Berry?

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I got three Gym Badges and still got beat by\nsome little kid?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I guess the Pokémon League won’t give you a\nserious interview unless you have eight badges...?

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Such beauty... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Such beauty, only to be marred by ugly piles of\njunk! I can’t stand it!

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Sorry, sorry! Guess I shouldn’t have taken out my\nfrustration on you!

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Is that one of those Team Star bases? I guess\nthey must have put a lot of effort into building it.

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Team Star! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I came here to join Team Star!

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: If I can’t even defeat a regular old student, will\nI even make the cut for Team Star...?

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I don’t yet have the strength for Team Star! Guess\nI’ll have to train up and try again... Whoof...

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The power of music! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: The power of music can bring joy to the world!

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Bow to the power of musiiiiiic!

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Maybe I should worry less about the power of\nmy music and more about the power of my team.

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_OL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I need a new job... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_OL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Maybe working at the Pokémon Center near here\nwould be more fun than my current job...

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_OL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Gaaah! I’ve got to go heal my Pokémon!

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_OL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Kids like you must keep the workers at the\nPokémon Center busy all the time!

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: (This is so boring...) ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: My boyfriend and I came here for a picnic, but I\nguess I’ve got some free time to battle you!

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oooh, how exciting!

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Honestly, who goes on a picnic for a date?\nAren’t picnics for kids?

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: (I hope this\ngoes well...) ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I came here for a picnic with my girlfriend! I’m so\nnervous! Help me calm my nerves!

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: No, I’m still so nervous! This was such a big step!\nIs a picnic too much, too fast?

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I can’t wait to hang out with my girlfriend, just\nmaking sandwiches and relaxing together!

entries.label: TRID_AREA24_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Isn’t that the\nschool where— ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA24_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Is there a woman named Miriam working at your\nschool? She and I once worked together.

entries.label: TRID_AREA24_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: It seems you’re getting a good education!

entries.label: TRID_AREA24_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
Miriam and I used to work together at a
Pokémon Center once upon a time.\c
Of course, we’ve each gone down our own paths,
but I’m glad to hear she’s still doing her best.

entries.label: TRID_AREA25_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Sea Pokémon! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA25_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I swam out here to catch Pokémon from the sea!

entries.label: TRID_AREA25_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oh no, swimming cramp!

entries.label: TRID_AREA25_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I’d swim to the very end of the seas if it meant\nfinding rare Pokémon!

entries.label: TRID_AREA26_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I can’t find it... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA26_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ve looked everywhere, but I just can’t find it!\c\nI can’t find my potential anywhere!

entries.label: TRID_AREA26_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Seems my potential doesn’t lie in battle, either...

entries.label: TRID_AREA26_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Children are just bursting with potential...\nMeanwhile, I feel like my bubble’s burst.
