entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Go, go, go! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Go, go, go, Geodude! My favorite little round\nbuddies—easy to pick up and carry with me!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oh no! It’s easy to hit their weaknesses too!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I heard that people in some regions throw\nGeodude at each other like a snowball fight!\r\nDo you think anybody would actually do that?

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: An outsider! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You must be that outsider Carmine was talkin’\nabout!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Well, no wonder people don’t like outsiders!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I don’t actually know what an outsider is...but if\nyou’re strong in battle, I like you!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Eek! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Eek! You’re one of those people from Paldea,\naren’t you?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: So this is the Paldean style of battle, huh?

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: That was so exciting for me! It was like a real\ncosmopolitan kinda battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: So blue... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Wooper’s so blue and cute—it’s totally adorable!\nDon’t you think so too?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Whoops... Now I’M the one who’s blue?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Wait, you’re telling me that in the region you’re\nfrom, Wooper aren’t blue—they’re BROWN?!\r\nThat’s actually...pretty adorable too.

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Hey there! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You’ve got to greet a person properly if you\nwant to have a pleasant battle. Now let’s go!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: There’s nothing like the warm glow of good\nsportsmanship!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Here in Kitakami, we expect Trainers to call out\nto one another before getting into a battle.\r\nIt’s probably the same where you’re from, right?

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: If you’re naughty... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: If you’re naughty, the scary ogre will come and\neat you up!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Scary ogre, please eat up this naughty Trainer!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: There’s a horrible, scary-looking ogre that lives\nup on Oni Mountain!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Up this way... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Up this way, you’ll find Loyalty Plaza! But we\nshould have a battle before you head in!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Now you’re ready to head in!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I’ve gotta tell you, though... Loyalty Plaza’s not\nall it’s cracked up to be. It’s just a big empty lot\r\nthat happens to have the Loyal Three Monument.

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Apples! I love ’em! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I love ’em raw, I love ’em cooked—I even love\n’em in battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oh, my darlin’ Applin...

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Y’know, there’s a place in Kitakami where they\njust leave out Syrupy Apples for folks to buy!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The Wistful Fields... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: The Pokémon in the Wistful Fields are strong.\nI’ll check whether you’re ready to go there.

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You’re more than ready!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Lots of people accidentally end up in the Wistful\nFields when they meant to go to Loyalty Plaza.

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Flap, flap, flap! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m looking for Pokémon that drop flaps!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: What a flop...

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Toedscool sometimes show up around here, but I\ncan’t ever seem to find any...

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: It’s festival time! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Have you been to the festival yet? It’s a special\nparty held every year at Kitakami Hall!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I think it’s time for a pity party over here!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Hope you have fun at the festival. Wish I could\nstill go...

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Oh, a new face... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You’re a new face around here. How about you\nand me battle?

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Never seen your kind of strength before.

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Oh, you came here on a school trip? Guess that’s\nwhy you seem so excited. Sounds nice.

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Kitakami Hall! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Kitakami Hall is bursting full of fun things to\ncheck out!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: The Festival of Masks is at Kitakami Hall too!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Have you met the caretaker at the community\ncenter? He’s actually my dad.

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: City kids... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I bet a soft little city kid like you can’t even climb\nthis mighty hill, ehhh?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I take it all back! Forgive me!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Didn’t expect you to be so slick at climbing hills.\nYou been training on a big stairway or something?

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Hoo! Hah! Huff! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m on my way to Kitakami Hall to make a\ndelivery. How ’bout you join me—for a battle?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You’re a tough one, all right!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The land of Kitakami is super hilly, so it’s a great\nchallenge for any courier worth their Nacli salt!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’m Kosuke! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: The name’s Kosuke. I’m a backpacker—and\nI’m lost!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Now I feel more lost than ever—lost and alone\nand defeated!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: When mountain climbing, it’s easier to get lost\non the way down than on the way up!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC1_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The mountains! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC1_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: When you come to the mountains, you can only\ndo two things!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC1_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: When you come to the mountains, you can only\nmountain climb and mountain battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC1_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I hear the people of Kitakami consider mountains\nlike this one to be sacred land.

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The Wistful Fields! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You should spend some time in the Wistful Fields!\nIf I have to battle you to convince you, I will!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Well? Did I convince you?

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The flowers that bloom in the Wistful Fields\nsimply wash away any cares you might have!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: A stranger... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m not supposed to talk to strangers!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: But now that we battled, I guess maybe that\nmakes us sorta friends...?

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Let’s battle again sometime, sorta-friend!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: My Goo... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: My precious little Goo loves dark places!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: No, Goo! Don’t go into the light!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Goomy love it when things are dark and gloomy\nand humid—so much that they can only evolve all\r\nthe way to Goodra in the right weather!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Let’s just enjoy it! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Let’s throw off all our suffering! This is no place\nfor any of that stuff!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oh. Apparently this IS the place for suffering...for\nme, anyway...

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I hope you enjoy the lovely Paradise Barrens that\nlie up ahead...

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You talkin’ to me, kid? You know what’ll happen\nif you come at me like this, don’tcha?

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: We were SUPPOSED to battle like that, right?\nThat’s how it works?

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: That was my first battle with another Trainer!\nPhew...I was super nervous!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: They’re all different! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: The Pokémon here in Kitakami are all different\nfrom the ones back in my region!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Hold up—are we from the same region?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I’m trying to find some real monstrous Pokémon,\nlike something out of a movie! Where are they?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_DLC1_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: That little hut! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_DLC1_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: That little hut is so weird—no one’s ever there!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_DLC1_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: At least there’s nobody around to see me lose!

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_DLC1_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: That little hut... No one’s ever there, yet you can\nstill buy apples from it all the same!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_DLC1_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Victory is—! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_DLC1_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Victory is 99 percent skill and one percent\nluck—and knowing that is the key to victory!

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_DLC1_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: W-wait...

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_DLC1_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Maybe luck is more of a factor than I thought...

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Watch out! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m going through a growth spurt, which means\nI’m super-duper strong right now!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oh, I gotta help my Pokémon grow too, huh...

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I’m going through a growth spurt! I grew a whole\ninch overnight!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: If you love me... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: “If you love me, let me go!” That’s what I told my\nparents—and now I’m here on my own journey!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Every journey has its ups and downs!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: It’s only when you leave home that you really\nstart to appreciate your family... Ironic, huh?

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_DLC1_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: How could I—?! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_DLC1_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: How could I have messed up this bad?! This is a\nkarate gi—but I only know judo!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_DLC1_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oh, this whole thing threw me for a loop!

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_DLC1_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: A judo gi is made of thicker material than a\nkarate gi, so it can stand up to all the tussling!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The Savanna Biome! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Welcome to the Savanna Biome! The plains here\nstretch as far as the eye can see!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Whoa, you’re a wild one!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: It’s really hard to keep your hair looking good\nhere. The heat and humidity cause so much frizz!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: How about a\nDouble Battle? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Think you’re good at Double Battles? Why don’t\nyou test that theory by battling me?

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You don’t have to tell me twice—you’re an ace at\nDouble Battles!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Double Battles are the norm here at Blueberry\nAcademy. You can pull out some tricky strategies\r\nwith ’em, which is what makes them so fun.

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The Elite Four of\nthe BB League! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: My goal is to defeat the BB League Elite Four!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: No way—are you in the upper ranks yourself?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The Savanna Biome’s Elite Four member is called\nCrispin. He’s only a first-year student here, but\r\nhis Pokémon are super strong!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I don’t feel like doing\nmy homework... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I really don’t want to do my homework, so I\nended up coming here to the Terarium.

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Even getting beat by you doesn’t make me want\nto go deal with my homework!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: “Write 800 words summarizing Pokémon Abilities\nand the advantages they can offer in battle”...?\r\nWho wants to do a thing like that?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Crispin of the\nElite Four... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Do you want to know why Crispin is strong\nenough to be a member of the Elite Four?

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Yeowch! You’re tough enough to take the heat\nof battling Crispin!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
Crispin uses Fire-type Pokémon, see, but he
manages to cover their weaknesses well, which
is why he’s so strong in battle.\c
If you’re not careful, he’ll turn the tables on you
with a fierce Solar Beam to the face!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: So much mud! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Playing in the mud is the best, right? I hope\nyou’re ready to have your face right in it!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oh, I ended up with mud on my face...

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Mud-Slap is a great move for dealing damage\nwhile also lowering your opponent’s accuracy!\r\nIt’s strong and smart! Mud really is the best!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’m knocking out\nsome BBQs! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m doing some BBQs with my pals during our\nbreak between classes!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Beating you is a quest I’ll never be able to\ncomplete!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: You can get even more BP when do you quests\nwith your friends than when you do them solo.\r\nYou did know that, right?

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Right in the middle\nof the Terarium! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Do you know what you’ll find right in the middle\nof the Terarium?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Well, I’m certainly not finding any victory here,\nthat’s for sure...

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: In the very middle of the Terarium is the Central\nPlaza—it’s a great meet-up spot!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Have a look at that\nTerarium Core! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Staring up at the Terarium Core on the ceiling\ngave me a real crick in my neck!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: At least the shock of losing is a great distraction\nfrom my neck pain!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Ms. Briar handles all the maintenance work on the\nTerarium Core, you know.

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Healing\nmachines! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m the best in my whole class at using the self-\nserve healing machines to heal up my team!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Well, I lost! Time to go use that healing machine!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: My dream is to work in a Pokémon Center one\nday—then I’ll use healing machines all the time!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Excuse me! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: So sorry to bother you, but do you know where\nwe are? I’m completely lost!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: So sorry for the poor show in battle, too!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I’m trying to reach the Central Plaza. Was it not\nthis way...?

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Are you lost? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Did you get lost and wander up here? Don’t\nworry, Sophie’s here to show you the way.

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I guess you had a thing or two to show me...

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: If you just follow the block walls, you’ll end up in\nthe Central Plaza every time. Easy!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Know what’s\nup ahead? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: The Coastal Biome lies on the other side of this\nwall here! You ready for a nice beach vacay?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oof, I think I could use a cool dip after that burn\nyou just gave me!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The Coastal Biome is so sunny and relaxing—and\nthe scenery! Boy, do I ever love the scenery!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Aren’t you...? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Aren’t you that exchange student everyone’s\ntalking about? Could I trouble you for a battle?

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Ah! I feel that Paldean spirit washing over me!

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: You came from Paldea, right? I really hope to\ngo there myself someday!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: An indoor sea... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: There’s a sea here, inside the Terarium’s dome...\nIs it the same as the sea outside, though?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Your strength is as vast and immeasurable as the\nsea itself!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: This school floats in the sea, but within the\nschool...is another sea...\c\nI feel out to sea tryin’ to wrap my head around it!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Maybe with Dig... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You know the Pokémon move Dig? I wonder if I\ncould tunnel right through this mountain with it...

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Looks like I dug myself into a hole there...

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
Pokémon can’t be hit by moves when they’re
underground using Dig!\c
EXCEPT! You’ve gotta watch out for Earthquake.
It not only hits—it does more damage than usual!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Alolan forms! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m raising Alolan Form Pokémon! Look!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Did you get a good look?! Those’re Alolan\nforms all right!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Even if you haven’t caught a Pokémon yourself,\nyou can check out some of their details in your\r\nPokédex if you’ve battled ’em at least once.

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: It’s all mine... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: This is my own private beach, that no one else\nknows about! What do you want?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I guess it’s a bit too private—I’m clearly out of\npractice for battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: This is basically a dead end, so I’m usually the\nonly one who bothers to come here.

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: No thoughts,\njust vibes... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m just vibing... You?

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Huh... Guess you managed to keep your focus.

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: When you’re all worn out, vibing is where it’s at.\nEverybody’s gotta empty their head sometimes.

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Double Battles! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: If you’re gonna have a Double Battle, then\nyou’ve gotta have strategy! Watch and learn!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: It hurts twice as much to lose a Double Battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: It’s important to consider how you can attack all\nopponents or protect yourself in a Double Battle!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: *sigh* ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: *sigh*\nHe just radiates coolness...

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oooh, he really is just the coolest!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
I’d like to talk to him before I graduate, but he’s
always on the move...\c
*sigh*
You’re so cool, Director Cyrano!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Into the Polar Biome! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I can do it! I’m all pumped up! I’m definitely\nready to venture into the Polar Biome!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: D’ahhh, I think I’ve got cold feet...

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: It’s SUPER cold in the Polar Biome, you know?!\c\nThey totally managed to give it an arctic feel.\nThe power of science—it’s sure something!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’m part of the Elite Four! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’m part of the Elite Four—the part that shows up\nto challenge them, that is!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: My cool self-intro was all for nothing...

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I was practicing my self-intro for when I become\na full-fledged member of the Elite Four, see.\r\nThen you showed up...

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Slowpoke! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I just LOVE Slowpoke! How about you?

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Slow-noooooo!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
The Slowpoke you find here in the Coastal
Biome are Galarian Slowpoke.\c
Apparently there are some fairly tropical areas
in Galar where Slowpoke are found!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I know Lacey’s secret! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I know Lacey’s secret! Shall I share it with you?

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Geez, cool your jets! I’ll tell you, all right?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
OK, you’ve earned it—I’ll tell you Lacey’s secret!\c
Apparently...Lacey sometimes takes naps using
one of her Pokémon’s soft tummy as a pillow!
Did you know that?

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I just love Alola! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ve become absolutely obsessed with the Alola\nregion since I came to this school!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: You may have beaten me in battle, but you can’t\nbeat me when it comes to my love of Alola!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I’m gonna take a trip to Alola soon! And I’ll\nfinally get to try those malasadas myself!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I simply adore\nbird Pokémon! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Ever since I entered this school, I’ve dedicated\nmyself wholeheartedly to training bird Pokémon!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Noooooo! Chirpy! Peeper!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: As long as bird Pokémon stay safely aloft,\nGround-type moves don’t hit them!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: It’s all about spirit! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: If you just put enough spirit in, there’s no way\nyou’ll lose! Here I go!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Th-that was a whole week’s worth of spirit\nfor me—!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I’m in real low spirits now, ’cause of you...

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Where am I?! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Where am I?! And who are you?! Wait, are you\nan opponent?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Wha-?! I’m losing it in here!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: This cave system is like a maze! Gets you lost and\nbewildered enough to battle everyone on sight...

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’m in the League Club! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Watch out—I’m a strong one! Why, you ask?\nBecause I’m in the League Club, that’s why!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Wait, but...I’m part of the League Club! How\ncould I have lost?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
I guess just being a part of a club isn’t enough
to guarantee anything.\c
You’ve still gotta work hard to be a worthy
member of it, huh!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: The Canyon Biome... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You new to the Canyon Biome? Don’t worry—\nI’ll show you the ropes.

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: W-wait! Aren’t you supposed to be new to this?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: There’re tons of cliffs to watch out for here. If\nyou run around willy-nilly, you’re bound to fall!\r\nBe careful, OK?

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Oh, Amarys! Most\nworthy Amarys! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Most worthy Amarys of the Elite Four! How I wish\nI might become strong enough to approach you!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oh, Amarys... Am I any closer now to the heights\nwhere you dwell?

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Our most worthy Amarys maintains a composed\nexterior, but she’s really very kind underneath!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: ... ... ...\nYou wanna battle?

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: ... ... ...\nGuess I lost, huh.

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I read an article that said the cool, silent type is\nalways popular with the ladies, but...is it really?

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Let’s do some\naddition! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Plusle! Minun! We’re going to add our power\ntogether to go all out!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I guess my contribution was the real minus here...

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Some Pokémon can power each other up when\nyou put them in a team together!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: All kinds of\nPokémon! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ll show you all kinds of Pokémon that I’ve found\nand caught here in the Terarium!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Thanks for showing me your Pokémon too!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: The Terarium was carefully set up to provide a\ngreat habitat for all kinds of different Pokémon.

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: And one, and two,\nand three, and... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Fou—oh! Look who’s here: a challenger to\ninterrupt our diligent training!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: For shame...

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: It would appear that our training still isn’t up to\nsnuff! Thanks for helping me see that!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: *sniffle* ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: *sniffle* I-I had the biggest blowup with my\nbest friend, and now I don’t know what to do!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I’m so sorry!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I guess a good apology is what you need after\nany fight, isn’t it? I’ve just got to say it!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Today’s the day! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Today’s the day that I finally defeat Amarys!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: D-defeated in the warm-up round?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I think I’d better practice a bit more before I try\nto challenge Amarys herself!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Gah?! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: What’re you—?! Why’s there—?! In a place like\nthis—?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Wait—I’m still reeling from the shock! What\nhappened? Did I just lose?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I’m not kidding—you’re probably the first person\nwho’s ever come here aside from me!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Behold! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ll take you on with my team, inspired by the\namazing Amarys herself!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Amazingly shocking, how badly that worked...

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: It was amazingly naive of me to think copying\na strong Trainer’s team would make me strong.

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: How romantic! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Don’t you think there’s something incredibly\nromantic about the giant rocks floating in here?

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: What a romantic defeat!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Did you know that the rocks in here float thanks\nto electromagnetic fields? Isn’t that amazing?\r\nThose fields are why Magnet Rise works, too!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Higher! And higher! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ll keep moving higher up the ranks of the BB\nLeague! I’m going to be one of the Elite Four!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Wh-what rank are you, kid?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: When you win, you move up the ranks. When\nyou lose, you move down ’em. If you’re not a\r\nconsistent winner, you’ll never reach the top.

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I just want... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I just want to enjoy school! I want to have fun in\nmy classes! And in my club after classes, too!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Well, that sure was fun!

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: My friends are always hung up on improving their\nrank in the League Club and that kind of stuff.\r\nThey don’t seem to be enjoying school at all.

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Team Terribull! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: We call ourselves Team Terribull! Be prepared\nto tremble in fright before our might!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oh, this is just Terribull...

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I still want to win using the Pokémon I love best!\nSo I’ll just keep working harder until I manage it!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Coming and going! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I just keep coming and going, back and forth\nbetween the Coastal Biome and the Polar one!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: What a sudden shock to the system!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Moving back and forth between the Coastal\nBiome and the Polar Biome is a shock, all right.\r\nIt really helps you toughen up!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Is this polar?! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I know this is called the Polar Biome, but what\ndoes “polar” mean anyway?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: P-p-po...

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Wait, “polar” is, like, the North or South Pole?\nWell, no wonder it’s so cold here!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Hehehehe... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hehehehe... Tell me...\c\nDo you like...occult mysteries?

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I guess you just like...Pokémon...

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I want to start...an occult club here at school.\nBut I can’t seem...to attract any members...

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Can’t stop it! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: No one can stop me! I’m on a total roll!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Whoa, you rolled right over me...

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I thought I’d be able to keep rolling up and up\nthrough the ranks of the BB League... Darn.

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Looking for the\nPolar Plaza? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You looking for the Polar Plaza? Want me to\nshow you the way there?

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Well, now my Pokémon are too exhausted to\nshow anyone anywhere!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: You can’t actually see it from here, but the Polar\nPlaza is just on the other side of that icy ridge.

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Ready for a\nchallenge? ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Thinking of challenging Drayton, are you? You’d\nonly be wasting his time—don’t even dream of it!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Er, never mind! Go right ahead!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I know Drayton acts like the whole world’s a joke,\nbut he doesn’t mess around in battles.

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I’m stuffed! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Urk... I ate enough to burst! I guess a Pokémon\nbattle after eating is a good way to aid digestion!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Urp!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
Everyone’s favorite meal at the cafeteria has got
to be the Academy Special!\c
You can only order it using BP, but the Meal
Powers it gives are amazing!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Because it’s there! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I climb the peak before me because it’s there!\nI beat the Trainer before me because [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she’s there!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: A truly formidable summit!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I love the mountains! My dream is to graduate\nfrom being a student to being a hiker someday!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: So cooold! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: My Pokémon are all so cooold!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Wow. That’s cold.

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Having a whole party of Ice types is like hanging\nout in the freezer section of the supermarket!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Please work out! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ve been snoozing through my Pokémon battle\nclasses, but please, please, please let this work!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: That didn’t even come close to working!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: I guess you can’t just slack off and expect things\nto work out—not with studies or with Pokémon...

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: It’s all to WIN! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ve been training the perfect party, all to WIN\nagainst the Polar Biome’s Elite Four member!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: It’s...super effective?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Drayton—the Elite Four member here in the Polar\nBiome—is the grandson of a famous Gym Leader.\r\nIt’s no wonder his team’s so strong.

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: My dream! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I’ve got to become one of the Elite Four of the\nBB League so my dream can come true at last!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Noooooo! This is going to make my rank go\nDOWN, not up!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: My dream is to become a member of the Elite\nFour...and make a castle out of the plaza blocks!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: You there! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: You there! What year are you in, huh?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I’m in my second year!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: It’s hard to know who’s above or below you in\nthis weird school because the kids’ ages have\r\nnothing to do with their school year!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: Wait, aren’t you... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Aren’t you that kid who was on the Iono Zone?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Whosawhatsit?! Iunno!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
I swear, there was a kid who looked just like you
on the Iono Zone.\c
The viewer count for that stream was totally
insane!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: I believe! ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: I believe in my Pokémon! Do you?!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: I can’t believe how strong you are!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: Pokémon are mysterious as anything, aren’t they?\c\nEven though they don’t speak our language, they\nalways seem to know what we’re thinking!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: If I only... ▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: If I only could’ve beat Crispin...then I’d be the\none in the Elite Four now!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Lost again!

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: OK! I’m ready to move on now!\c\nYou’ve gotta recognize your failures, but that\ndoesn’t mean you’ve gotta have regrets!

entries.label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_MUSHI_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_MUSHI_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Oh, my! Beautiful job!

entries.label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_MUSHI_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_KUSA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_KUSA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Avant-GARDE!

entries.label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_KUSA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_DENKI_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_DENKI_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Y-you...smashed...that subscribe button.

entries.label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_DENKI_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_MIZU_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_MIZU_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: What a great catch!

entries.label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_MIZU_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_HIKOU_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [EMPTY 2144]

entries.label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_HIKOU_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
